affinity.title: affinity
affinity.description: Affinity and anti-affinity rules used to constrain pod scheduling.

appBaseUrl.title: appBaseUrl
appBaseUrl.description: appBaseUrl is the full public URL of the Papra instance (required).

customOAuthProviders.title: customOAuthProviders
customOAuthProviders.description:
customOAuthProviders configures custom OAuth/OIDC providers (AUTH_PROVIDERS_CUSTOMS).
Client secrets are provided via oidcSecret/oidcExternalSecret below.
See the better-auth generic-oauth plugin docs for field details.

firstUserAsAdmin.title: firstUserAsAdmin
firstUserAsAdmin.description: firstUserAsAdmin promotes the first registered user to admin.

ipAddressHeaders.title: ipAddressHeaders
ipAddressHeaders.description: ipAddressHeaders lists headers used to determine the client IP (for reverse proxy setups).

isRegistrationEnabled.title: isRegistrationEnabled
isRegistrationEnabled.description: isRegistrationEnabled controls whether new users can self-register.

auth.title: auth
auth.description: auth configures Papra's authentication and registration behavior.

driver.title: driver
driver.description: driver is the document storage backend. This chart only wires up filesystem and s3.

bucket.title: bucket
bucket.description: bucket is the S3 bucket name used to store documents. Only used when driver=s3.

endpoint.title: endpoint
endpoint.description: endpoint is the S3-compatible endpoint URL. Leave empty to use the default AWS endpoint.

forcePathStyle.title: forcePathStyle
forcePathStyle.description: forcePathStyle enables path-style S3 addressing (required for MinIO and most self-hosted S3).

region.title: region
region.description: region is the AWS region of the S3 bucket. Only used when driver=s3.

s3.title: s3
s3.description: s3 settings are only used when driver=s3.

storage.title: storage
storage.description: storage configures Papra's document storage backend (DOCUMENT_STORAGE_* environment variables).

config.title: config
config.description: config holds Papra application configuration, rendered into the Deployment's environment variables.

fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride
fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the full name of the release used to generate resource names.

digest.title: digest
digest.description:
digest pins to an immutable image reference, overriding `tag` when set. Prepend
`sha256:` or omit the prefix.

pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy
pullPolicy.description: The image pull policy controlling when Kubernetes re-pulls the image.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: The container image repository to pull the Papra image from.

tag.title: tag
tag.description: rootless variant runs as a non-root user; matches podSecurityContext/securityContext below.

imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets
imagePullSecrets.description:
This is for the secrets for pulling an image from a private repository. More information can
be found at https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/pull-image-private-registry/

accessModes.title: accessModes
accessModes.description: accessModes are the PVC access modes to request for the ingestion folder volume.

size.title: size
size.description: size is the ingestion folder PVC capacity. Ignored when existingClaimName is set.

storageClassName.title: storageClassName
storageClassName.description: storageClassName is the Kubernetes storage class to use for the ingestion folder PVC. Empty string uses the cluster default.

volumeName.title: volumeName
volumeName.description:
volumeName explicitly binds the PVC to a specific PV by name.
Leave empty for dynamic provisioning.
Automatically set to the chart-managed PV when volume.nfs.server is configured.

claim.title: claim
claim.description: claim configures the PVC created by this chart. Ignored when existingClaimName is set.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: enabled turns on Papra's ingestion folder feature and mounts the configured volume into the container.

existingClaimName.title: existingClaimName
existingClaimName.description:
existingClaimName uses a pre-existing PVC instead of creating one.
When set, claim and volume below are ignored entirely.

mountPath.title: mountPath
mountPath.description: mountPath is the path inside the Papra container where the share is mounted.

pollingIntervalMs.title: pollingIntervalMs
pollingIntervalMs.description: pollingIntervalMs is the interval, in milliseconds, between polling scans of the ingestion folder. Only used when usePolling is true.

postProcessingStrategy.title: postProcessingStrategy
postProcessingStrategy.description:
postProcessingStrategy controls what Papra does with a file after it has been ingested.

- `delete` removes the file from the ingestion folder.
- `move` moves the file to the post-processing move folder instead of deleting it.

usePolling.title: usePolling
usePolling.description:
usePolling enables polling-based file watching instead of inotify.
Must be true for NFS, SMB, and other network filesystems.

mountOptions.title: mountOptions
mountOptions.description: mountOptions are the NFS mount options applied to the PersistentVolume.

path.title: path
path.description: path is the exported path on the NFS server to mount.

server.title: server
server.description: server is the NFS server hostname or IP. Leave empty to skip PV creation.

nfs.title: nfs
nfs.description: nfs configures a static PersistentVolume backed by an NFS export.

volume.title: volume
volume.description:
volume creates a static PersistentVolume bound to the chart's PVC.
Useful for NFS or other manually-provisioned shares.
Set volume.nfs.server to enable PV creation; leave empty to skip.

ingestionFolder.title: ingestionFolder
ingestionFolder.description:
ingestionFolder configures Papra's built-in ingestion folder feature.
Papra watches <mountPath>/<org-id>/ for files to automatically ingest.
Find your org ID in the Papra UI under Settings -> Organization.

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress resource.

className.title: className
className.description: The IngressClass to use for the Ingress resource. Empty string uses the cluster default.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource for exposing Papra outside the cluster.

hosts.title: hosts
hosts.description: A list of host rules used to configure the Ingress.

tls.title: tls
tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress, specifying secrets and the hosts they cover.

ingress.title: ingress
ingress.description: This block is for setting up the ingress, more information can be found at https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

nameOverride.title: nameOverride
nameOverride.description: This is to override the chart name.

nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector
nodeSelector.description: Node selector labels used to constrain which nodes the pod can be scheduled on.

clientSecrets.title: clientSecrets
clientSecrets.description: clientSecrets is used when create=true. Map of providerId -> clientSecret.

create.title: create
create.description:
create controls whether the chart creates the OIDC Secret.
Defaults to false — provide a pre-existing Secret via secretName instead,
or set create=true and supply values below only for local/dev use.

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName overrides the generated Secret name when set.
Defaults to <fullname>-oidc when empty.

oidcSecret.title: oidcSecret
oidcSecret.description:
oidcSecret configures how custom OAuth provider client secrets are provided.
The generated Secret holds one key per provider, named <providerId>-client-secret.

existingClaimName.title: existingClaimName
existingClaimName.description:
existingClaimName uses a pre-existing PVC instead of creating one (e.g. one bound to a
manually-provisioned PV). When set, storageClassName and size below are ignored.

size.title: size
size.description: size is the PVC capacity. Ignored when existingClaimName is set.

storageClassName.title: storageClassName
storageClassName.description: storageClassName is the Kubernetes storage class to use. Empty string uses the cluster default.

appData.title: appData
appData.description: appData configures the PVC that backs Papra's /app/app-data directory (SQLite database and local document storage).

persistence.title: persistence
persistence.description: persistence configures the PVC that backs /app/app-data (SQLite DB + local document storage).

podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations
podAnnotations.description:
This is for setting Kubernetes Annotations to a Pod.
For more information see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

podLabels.title: podLabels
podLabels.description:
This is for setting Kubernetes Labels to a Pod.
For more information see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

fsGroup.title: fsGroup
fsGroup.description: fsGroup is the supplemental group applied to mounted volumes (e.g. the app-data PVC).

runAsGroup.title: runAsGroup
runAsGroup.description: runAsGroup is the primary GID the container process runs as.

runAsNonRoot.title: runAsNonRoot
runAsNonRoot.description: runAsNonRoot requires the container to run as a non-root user.

runAsUser.title: runAsUser
runAsUser.description: runAsUser is the UID the container process runs as.

type.title: type
type.description: type selects which seccomp profile to apply to the pod.

seccompProfile.title: seccompProfile
seccompProfile.description: seccompProfile configures the seccomp profile applied to the pod.

podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext
podSecurityContext.description: Security context settings applied at the pod level.

replicaCount.title: replicaCount
replicaCount.description:
Papra stores its database in a single SQLite file on the app-data PVC, so this must stay
at 1. Scaling beyond 1 replica risks corrupting the database from concurrent writers.

memory.title: memory
memory.description: memory is the maximum memory amount the container may use (e.g. 512Mi).

limits.title: limits
limits.description: limits are the maximum CPU/memory resources the container may use.

cpu.title: cpu
cpu.description: cpu is the requested CPU amount (e.g. 100m).

memory.title: memory
memory.description: memory is the requested memory amount (e.g. 256Mi).

requests.title: requests
requests.description: requests are the minimum CPU/memory resources guaranteed to the container.

resources.title: resources
resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the application container.

accessKeyId.title: accessKeyId
accessKeyId.description: accessKeyId is the S3 access key ID. Used when create=true; stored in the Secret's "access-key-id" field.

create.title: create
create.description:
create controls whether the chart creates the S3 Secret.
Defaults to false — provide a pre-existing Secret via secretName instead,
or set create=true and supply values below only for local/dev use.

secretAccessKey.title: secretAccessKey
secretAccessKey.description: secretAccessKey is the S3 secret access key. Used when create=true; stored in the Secret's "secret-access-key" field.

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName overrides the generated Secret name when set.
Defaults to <fullname>-s3 when empty.

s3Secret.title: s3Secret
s3Secret.description: s3Secret configures the S3 credentials (only used when config.storage.driver=s3).

authSecret.title: authSecret
authSecret.description: authSecret is used when create=true. Must be at least 32 characters.

create.title: create
create.description:
create controls whether the chart creates the Secret.
Defaults to false — provide a pre-existing Secret via secretName instead (e.g. an
ExternalSecret), or set create=true and supply values below only for local/dev use.

databaseEncryptionKey.title: databaseEncryptionKey
databaseEncryptionKey.description: databaseEncryptionKey is used when create=true and encryptionKeyEnabled is true.

encryptionKeyEnabled.title: encryptionKeyEnabled
encryptionKeyEnabled.description:
encryptionKeyEnabled wires DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY from the secret's
"database-encryption-key" field. Encrypts the SQLite database at rest.
Losing this key permanently makes the database unrecoverable.

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName overrides the generated Secret name when set.
When create=false, this must name the pre-existing Secret to use.
Defaults to the chart fullname when empty.

secret.title: secret
secret.description: secret configures the AUTH_SECRET (and optional DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY) credentials.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.title: allowPrivilegeEscalation
allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: allowPrivilegeEscalation controls whether a process can gain more privileges than its parent process.

drop.title: drop
drop.description: drop is the list of Linux capabilities to remove from the container.

capabilities.title: capabilities
capabilities.description: capabilities configures the Linux capabilities added to or dropped from the container.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.title: readOnlyRootFilesystem
readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: readOnlyRootFilesystem mounts the container's root filesystem as read-only.

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description: readOnlyRootFilesystem is false because papra writes to /app/app-data at runtime.

port.title: port
port.description: port is the HTTP port papra listens on and the Service exposes.

type.title: type
type.description: The type of Kubernetes Service to create.

service.title: service
service.description: This is for setting up a service, more information can be found at https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automount.title: automount
automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?

create.title: create
create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.title: name
name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

serviceAccount.title: serviceAccount
serviceAccount.description:
This section builds out the service account. More information can be found at
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/

tolerations.title: tolerations
tolerations.description: Tolerations allowing the pod to be scheduled onto nodes with matching taints.
